assessment_na_reason_check.name: assessment_na_reason_check
assessment_na_reason_check.value: ("criterion_assessment"."status" = 'not_applicable' AND "criterion_assessment"."not_applicable_reason" IS NOT NULL AND char_length(btrim("criterion_assessment"."not_applicable_reason")) BETWEEN 10 AND 500) OR ("criterion_assessment"."status" <> 'not_applicable' AND "criterion_assessment"."not_applicable_reason" IS NULL)

measure_status_completed_check.name: measure_status_completed_check
measure_status_completed_check.value: ("measure"."status" = 'done' AND "measure"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL) OR ("measure"."status" <> 'done' AND "measure"."completed_at" IS NULL)
